provenance.title: Burp
provenance.citation: ezwa. Burp. PDSounds recording 647, mirrored by Wikimedia Commons.
provenance.acquisitionNotes: A natural human belch. The OGG is the unchanged Wikimedia Commons file; the WAV is a deterministic PCM16 analysis derivative with no trimming or normalization.

annotation.basis: Visible primary belch onset and decay in the recording spectrogram.

provenance.title: wet fart + tummy rumbles
provenance.citation: natalie. wet fart + tummy rumbles. PDSounds recording 192, mirrored by Wikimedia Commons.
provenance.acquisitionNotes: A natural two-month-old infant recording containing a diaper-muffled wet fart and tummy rumbles; it is not an isolated adult fart. The OGG is unchanged; the WAV is a deterministic PCM16 analysis derivative with no trimming or normalization.

annotation.basis: First named event and first sustained low-frequency spectrogram region.
Following extended sequence of low-frequency internal pulses.
